title: A Finite De Bruijn Certificate Improving the Upper Bound for One-Round Randomized 2-Coloring of Cycles: Source and Reproducibility Package
description: Source, manuscript, deterministic n=497 local-search reproducer, exact n=497 and n=281 certificate checkers, frozen logs, and source/prepublication audits accompanying the preprint A Finite De Bruijn Certificate Improving the Upper Bound for One-Round Randomized 2-Coloring of Cycles.
